/blog/: Magazine front and blog with reading-width layout.
/framework/core/: Ten core classes every site uses, one mental model.
/framework/core/App/: Boot and the one container pages mount into.
/framework/core/Item/: A persistent tree node with data, items, and events.
/framework/core/Layout/: Thirty arrangements proven at seven widths; click to see one.
/framework/core/List/: The ordered collection behind item.items, an Item detail.
/framework/core/Page/: A URL with content and children; every page.js creates one.
/framework/core/Router/: Everything between a URL change and the DOM reflecting it.
/framework/core/Search/: The site corpus and its search box, press / to open.
/framework/core/Section/: A page inside a page; pick a layout to define slots.
/framework/core/Sidebar/: A brand over links and a resizable edge; includes theme toggle.
/framework/core/View/: Every HTML tag is a function; pass a function for content.
/framework/core/new/: Design proof archive; do not import. Read only.
/framework/ext/AITask/: The AI log displayed as task pages, day dashboards and board.
/framework/ext/Ask/: Talk to Claude from the browser; ask questions, pick elements, get feedback.
/framework/ext/DesignTool/: Measures layouts numerically — broken, off, or good with no AI.
/framework/ext/Doc/: A module as a page: files and members, each backed by markdown
/framework/ext/Draggable/: Grab-and-move for any view; Sortable crosses lists and nests.
/framework/ext/Dropdown/: One choice from a list — picture and name, never clipped.
/framework/ext/JSONL/: Append-only logs the AI blindly appends to; replayed into object state.
/framework/ext/Omnibox/: Moved to core/Search; this is a deprecated pointer.
/framework/ext/Panel/: Chrome for arranging regions — divide, drag, align, fill and persist.
/framework/ext/Research/: Questions dug by minions into append-only files, rendered live.
/framework/ext/Saver/: JSON persistence — save, load, delete over one write queue.
/framework/ext/Timeline/: H/V timeline for dated items — CSS-vars, zoom, greedy lanes.
/framework/ext/catalog/: Same preview cards, two views: a sticky rail or a filterable wall
/framework/ext/demo/: Show the code, then run it: the site one demo mechanism
/framework/ext/depth/: A page becomes a 3D scene, layers drift as you scroll
/framework/ext/drawer/: The right rail anything can open, closed only by its own X
/framework/ext/editor/: A drag-and-drop block builder: a page you visit, not a module
/framework/ext/files/: A tree of real files, fetched, beside the one you clicked
/framework/ext/grip/: A rail's resize edge — a strip inside the edge it drags
/framework/ext/highlight/: Syntax highlighting for the code() factory, on every page that shows code
/framework/ext/layout/: A toolbar over anything, and a drawer that pushes the page over
/framework/ext/markdown/: md() renders prose; md.file() loads a whole markdown file into a View
/framework/ext/tabs/: A bar of links and the panel its children mount into
/framework/ext/toc/: This page's own headings, as a nav, with the current one marked.
/framework/styles/: Four layers, six type levels, and as little else as possible.
/framework/ui/: Twenty components in four bands, three functions, seventeen copy-paste markup
/framework/ux/: The behavior tier: ui/ hands you markup, ux/ hands you a class
/imagine/: Column host with grouped rail, one row, four categories.
/imagine/cms/: Markdown and dev socket seams become a full CMS without a backend.
/imagine/codrops/: Twelve effects ported from Codrops, grouped by animation mechanism type.
/imagine/design/: Screenshot-based design analysis of the site with ten focused study pages.
/imagine/feeds/: YouTube picker, multi-view dataset, and live API in one column.
/imagine/gallery/: Framework pages borrowed and previewed, explained in Answers child.
/imagine/game/: Text adventure using navigation, persistence, and a trading system.
/imagine/generated/: Export a tree, edit it. One seed exported so far.
/imagine/importance/: Which matters more? Rank by comparison.
/imagine/paging/: Configure pages with six words. See them live.
/imagine/platform/: Topics as worlds. One working demo included.
/imagine/research/: Four topics, streamed live, rated by confidence.
/imagine/review/: What strangers said. What it meant. The gap.
/imagine/scenes/: 3D pager: page tree is scene graph, click objects to navigate.
/imagine/stream/: Edit in one tab, live in every other, no reload.
/imagine/team/: Roster, boards, draggable tasks remembered by URL.
/imagine/vary/: Four labs: scroll, tone, place, four column looks.
/imagine/youtube/: Six API labs: panel, course, yield, split, chat, marks.
/layouts/: Every layout named, defined and drawn at three widths.
/layouts/browse/: Every layout on the site in three tiers, approve or improve each.
/layouts/doc/: Naming rules, wire spec, and settlement record for the standard.
/layouts/labs/: Six shape experiments moved from /imagine/, arrangements earning ids.
/layouts/practice/: Three layouts built big, filled with site content and decisions.
/layouts/shell/: Resizable sidebar and tree of homepage designs varying one change at a time.
/layouts/tag/: Click any tag to see every layout that carries it.
/notes/: Photographed notebook pages, transcribed and linked.
/web/: Live guide to web patterns and layout principles.
/websites/: Real sites tagged by layout, shown at four widths.
